prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A thin column of white smoke rises straight up from a small altar of rough field stones on an empty green hillside, a family in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, kneeling around it with their backs to the camera, wide mountains behind. Morning, clear sky. Holy and still. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
